domain_method: Ordered prompt keyword rules; preliminary heuristic labels.
language_method: langdetect on prompt and response separately after removing fenced code and URLs. English and uncertain examples retained.
language_limitations: Automatic detection can misclassify technical or multilingual text. Short/code-heavy examples remain uncertain.
leakage_checks: Exact normalized prompts, responses, and conversation IDs are grouped. Semantic near-duplicates are not guaranteed to be grouped.
